summary: A real, unclaimed target: at turn_1 the o GEMM is one serial main-stream nvjet_sm90_tst_112x128 call, 39.7 us sliding / 38.9 us full in the best job's profile, against a 12.8 us math floor. The Triton replacement sits behind a sound interleaved cold-L2 selector with a kernel-name assert, so one run can be read from the profile row. Move the phase to the END of prepare(): before rega-lo and fsilu it risks pushing fsilu past its 200 s start deadline, which would confound the result.
justification: ec3bd018's profile: nvjet_sm90_tst_112x128_64x7_1x2_h_bz_TNN 1 call, 39.7 us sliding / 38.9 us full turn_1; the other dense GEMMs at T=753 (128x192 coopB) run ~85% of peak. The unpooler (same M, N=8192, 4x the FLOPs) takes ~1.5x o's time: cuBLAS's K=1024 pick (small non-coop 112x128) is poor. Saving 20 us on both turn_1 shapes is ~2.4% of the turn_1 load, ~0.8% headline: judge on the profile row. Weakest link: per-tile prologue + partial wave does not explain a 2.5x gap; operand ingest (L2->SM ~6 TB/s, no multicast for plain Triton loads) matters: 128x256 moves ~148 MB (~25 us), 128x128 ~201 MB (~33 us), 64x256 ~252 MB (~42 us, worse). Realistic -10 to -15 us per shape; a 256x128 (8 warps, 3 stages, ~147 KB smem) is a better third candidate than 64x256. Prior (cuBLASLt algo picks, do-not-try) is a different mechanism.
confounders: experts-rega-w13-fast-silu-epilogue: its phase has a 200 s start deadline and started at ~167.7 s; o-proj placed before it could make it skip and drop fsilu's turn_1 gain, confounding exactly the load o-proj targets.
rega-lo phase (185 s start deadline): same exposure with more margin; confirm '[rega-lo] PATH CHOSEN low: master (variant 0 ...)'.
sglang-pipeline-parity: the incumbent; keep the [T,8192] bf16 contiguous layout attn_boundary consumes.
interference: No companion. Run the phase LAST (after _rega_fsilu_phase, before the final summary) with its own start (~245 s) and step (~270 s) deadlines; confirm all three fsilu PATH CHOSEN lines read ON and rega-lo picked variant 0.
rules_flags: No rule problem: BF16 weights unmodified, fp32 accumulation with a single bf16 rounding, nothing cached, branches on tokens only, no host syncs; JIT/profiling/timing in prepare.
Graph-capture hazard: T=300, 600, 753, 1506, 4096 also take this path; mark M (and other size args) do_not_specialize or warm an M%16==0 variant in prepare.
